newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia late palm olein down on weak demand.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia late palm olein down on weak demand.

text.p: Indonesian palm olein prices edged down in late trading on Thursday on sustained limited buying interest, traders said.

They said palm olein was quoted at 1,390-95 rupiah/kg in Jakarta, down from 1,400-05 rupiah at the opening, but offers were also heard at 1,380-85 rupiah. Crude palm oil was last done at 1,241 rupiah/kg at a tender in Medan.
"Prices have gone below the 1,400-rupiah level and the talk is that there is still some downside left," one trader said. "But I think prices will rebound after easing a little more."
Refiners said there was no refining margin at the current level of palm olein prices.
"Crude palm oil prices are high, they will leave us with no margin if we process it into olein for the local market," one trader said. "Refiners are finding it unprofitable."
Traders said a crude palm oil tender on Friday should give the market some price direction.
